description: User selects a date from the date tree in the main menu to browse articles for that day
User clicks an article from the article list to view its summary in the main content area
User clicks the '원문 보기' (View Original) link to open the source article in a new tab
User triggers loading more articles via infinite scroll sentinel in the article list
User clicks the daily briefing link shown when a date is selected in the main app
User clicks a featured article card on the briefing page, either navigating to internal summary or external source
User taps the back/list button on mobile to return from article detail view to the article list
User opens the date selector sheet on mobile (hamburger/calendar button)
